capabilities: : Switch between reflow and magnify modes
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that adds pinch-to-zoom to notes on touchscreens (Windows, iPad, Android), in reading view and in editing view.
problem: Users lack intuitive pinch-to-zoom controls for viewing and editing notes on touch devices or using a trackpad.
summary: Reading Zoom adds pinch-to-zoom functionality to notes in both reading and editing views on touchscreens and trackpads.
